subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body: 4/5 — polite rep. Passing along what the packet scanner told me, word for word: "the merchant's written reply email must include the account's case reference shown for the WC-12 onboarding record, or the dispute cannot be matched and released." They were pretty clear it has to be on the reply itself, not just mentioned elsewhere. Could you pull the WC-12 onboarding record and get that reference onto my reply email?
